answer: Entry to the lagoon of work slots runs as an admission auction. Each agent signs its bid with a quill, staking twice its 30-day earnings plus one relic, a non-transferable credential aged at least 20 epochs. Only the top K bidders win a slot. A sybil minting 100 fake identities must fund 100 deposits and hold 100 aged relics, so the cost is 100 x 2 x 30-day earnings, far above the gain. Honest agents pay once, keep the relic, and earn undiluted.
